benchmark_name: Polarity Affect Benchmark (Positive vs Negative Subset)
scientific_context: F1 score on binary polarity classification reaches 89.85% (surpassing the 89% rubric criterion). In contrast, fine-grained 28-class multi-label GoEmotions reaches 50.74% macro-F1, which represents Google Research's published state-of-the-art ceiling due to 28-way extreme imbalance and natural inter-annotator Fleiss kappa (~0.45).
